notes.title: Weekly Update - 0.3.3
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633568/69dce3cda2a8f2f7591c7c5b9e5909e8feacf8ea.png"][/img][/p][p]Regarding the current leaderboard records for 1st to 3rd place, after thoroughly reviewing currency acquisition, upgrades, unit ownership, and clear times, we have confirmed abnormal play patterns. As a result, these records will be treated as exceptions. If you have any questions regarding this matter, please contact us at:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://jdlbizcontact@gmail.com"]jdlbizcontact@gmail.com[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]To strengthen the fairness of the leaderboard, today’s update includes the first defensive measure: game data encryption. We will continue to monitor and take action against abnormal play.[/p][p]In addition, we have prepared a Combat System Playbook that explains ELARIENNE’s damage calculation mechanics. You can find the details at the link below. If you have further questions, please leave them in the discussion forum, and we will respond as quickly as possible.[/p][list][*][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/3304340/discussions/0/594034489924496177/"]Combat System Playbook[/url][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]QoL[/h3][list][*][p]Added sound effect and UI text when achieving a Merge Great Success.[/p][/*][*][p]Several rune descriptions have been revised for better clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]We have optimized the game to reduce frame drops that occurred when summoning or holding a large number of units, providing a more stable gameplay experience.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Balance Changes[/h3][list][*][p]The following runes that enhance certain skills now apply their bonuses as multiplicative to skill damage:[/p][list][*][p][b]Arcane Overdrive[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ancient Marks[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Sniper of War[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Human Ignite mechanism updated:[/p][list][*][p][b]Before:[/b] Ignite damage was based on the final damage that triggered Ignite.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Now:[/b] If a unit under Ignite receives additional Ignite applications from multiple units before the first damage tick occurs, Ignite damage from all contributing units will apply together. However, repeated attacks from the same unit will not stack.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Human Physical Penetration adjusted: [b]50 → 35[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where clearing the wave 150 epic boss would occasionally not result in victory.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tooltip positions displaying incorrectly under certain resolution settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Hawk Eye’s Attack Power bonus was applied twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Arcane Overdrive rune’s damage calculation was applied twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved orc unit pathfinding when there was enough space to move directly to the destination.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the High Income rune was activated immediately upon acquisition.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Economic Boom rune was activated immediately upon acquisition.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect character portraits being displayed in the damage information window.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.3.0
notes.content:
[h2]Our Second Update Announcement![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633568/33fccd0c11432c0ea5117165a8ac72dc00c156ed.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In the first week after launch, we were thrilled to see players enjoy nearly [b]10,000 matches[/b].
Based on your gameplay data and feedback, we will do our best to improve not only the base mode, but also enhance the quality of [b]Co-op Mode[/b] and [b]Hard Mode[/b].[/p][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p]Leaderboard[/p][p]A new [b]Leaderboard menu[/b] has been added to the in-game lobby.[/p][p]In the leaderboard, you can check other players’ best records as well as your own ranking.[/p][p]Records are displayed up to the [b]Top 100[/b], based on your best performance. The ranking criteria are as follows:[/p][olist][*][p][b]If you defeat the Wave 150 Boss[/b] → Higher remaining time is ranked higher[/p][/*][*][p][b]If you fail to defeat the Wave 150 Boss[/b] → Lower remaining boss HP is ranked higher[/p][/*][*][p][b]Highest wave reached[/b][/p][p][b]If defeated in an Epic Boss battle[/b] → Lower remaining boss HP is ranked higher[/p][p][b]If defeated in a normal wave[/b] → Higher total kills is ranked higher[/p][p][i]Any abnormal play records will be reviewed and deleted at our discretion.[/i][/p][/*][/olist][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]QoL[/h2][list][*][p]You can now move the screen using the keyboard arrow keys.[/p][/*][*][p]You can also move the screen by clicking and holding the mouse wheel button, then moving the mouse.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Balance Changes[/h2][p]Based on recent data, we found that an excessive amount of [b]Blue Souls[/b] was accumulating in the early stages. This caused certain support runes to become overly dominant, leading to early-game strategies becoming too rigid.[/p][p]We believe this situation could have a major impact on upcoming new content and the overall game balance. Therefore, in this update, we have adjusted the balance among support runes to encourage a wider variety of strategies.[/p][p]Moving forward, we will continue to monitor the game to ensure that no single meta becomes [b]overly[/b] entrenched, and we will keep improving the game so that more strategies and combinations can thrive.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Heroes[/b][/p][list][*][p]The base Berserk activation chance for Orc 3★–8★ has been increased from 10% → 20%.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Special Summon[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tier 7 Special Summon cost reduced from 10 Red Souls → 7 Red Souls.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Rune Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Ultra Berserk[/b]: Orc Attack Power during Berserk increased from 1.5× → 2×.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Savage Roar[/b]: Orc Attack Speed increased from +30% → +35%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mighty Flame[/b]: Human Ignite DPS increased from Attack Power 30% + (70% → 100%).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pact of Frost[/b]: Elf Attack Power increase per upgrade reduced from 50% → 30%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Totem of Opportunity[/b]: Generates 10–100 Blue Souls every 7 waves → every 5 waves.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gambler’s Instinct[/b]: Chance to double Blue Soul sell price increased from 12% → 17%.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season of Harvest[/b]: Blue Souls gained on 1% chance kill reduced from 60 → 45.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Continuous Luck[/b]: “This Kind of Luck” rune effect increased reduced from 20% → 15%.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where units could still be summoned with [b]Q[/b] while the game was paused with [b]Esc[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where achievements could not be unlocked after clearing wave 150[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the damage % of Elf 8★ [i]Ice Blast[/i] was displayed incorrectly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where units would move when right-clicking the sell window while a unit was selected[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature:
Leaderboard
A new [b]Leaderboard menu[/b] has been added to the in-game lobby.
You can now move the screen using the keyboard arrow keys.
You can also move the screen by clicking and holding the mouse wheel button, then moving the mouse.

tags.balance_change: The base Berserk activation chance for Orc 3★–8★ has been increased from 10% → 20%.
Tier 7 Special Summon cost reduced from 10 Red Souls → 7 Red Souls.
Ultra Berserk: Orc Attack Power during Berserk increased from 1.5× → 2×.
Savage Roar: Orc Attack Speed increased from +30% → +35%.
Mighty Flame: Human Ignite DPS increased from Attack Power 30% + (70% → 100%).
Pact of Frost: Elf Attack Power increase per upgrade reduced from 50% → 30%.
Totem of Opportunity: Generates 10–100 Blue Souls every 7 waves → every 5 waves.
Gambler’s Instinct: Chance to double Blue Soul sell price increased from 12% → 17%.
Season of Harvest: Blue Souls gained on 1% chance kill reduced from 60 → 45.
Continuous Luck: “This Kind of Luck” rune effect increased reduced from 20% → 15%.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where units could still be summoned with [b]Q[/b] while the game was paused with [b]Esc[/b]
Fixed an issue where achievements could not be unlocked after clearing wave 150
Fixed an issue where the damage % of Elf 8★ [i]Ice Blast[/i] was displayed incorrectly
Fixed an issue where units would move when right-clicking the sell window while a unit was selected

notes.title: Hotfix - 0.2.1
notes.content:
[p]We have fixed the following issues, and the changes will take effect after restarting the game.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where alert and warning messages were displayed as “ㅁ” in Simplified/Traditional Chinese environments.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the damage information UI showed values larger than they actually were.
[i]Cause: Even after enemies were defeated, remaining projectiles or Ignite DoT damage were still being counted in the UI calculations. This did not affect actual in-game damage or gameplay.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing! We will continue to improve and strive to provide you with a better experience.[/p]

tags.bug: [p]Fixed an issue where alert and warning messages were displayed as “ㅁ” in Simplified/Traditional Chinese environments.[/p]

[p]Fixed an issue where the damage information UI showed values larger than they actually were.
[i]Cause: Even after enemies were defeated, remaining projectiles or Ignite DoT damage were still being counted in the UI calculations. This did not affect actual in-game damage or gameplay.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to our very first update since the official launch![/h2][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633568/bc73e94d9c4741fa0bae7f70632951dc864691aa.gif"][/img][/h2][p][/p][p]Thanks to your invaluable feedback, we've focused this patch on improving your gameplay experience with key quality-of-life enhancements and stability fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]We are always listening and are committed to building a better Ellariene together. Please find the detailed changes below, and as always, we look forward to your feedback![/p][p][/p][p][b]What's Next?[/b][/p][p]We are hard at work on our next major feature: [b]2-Player Co-op Mode![/b] We are targeting a release for later this September and can't wait to share more details soon.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p]Detailed Combat Stats HUD[/p][p]You can now view detailed damage statistics for the current wave by pressing the [b]Tab[/b] key in-game.
This HUD displays the [b]Total Damage categorized by race and tier of current enemies[/b], along with the breakdown of [b]Base Damage[/b] and [b]Skill Damage[/b]. Additionally, we have included information about the Armor Reduction from physical and magic resistance for the current wave, based on your collected Runes and upgrade progress.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]New Runes[/p][list][*][p]Attack Rune[/p][list][*][p][i][b]Pact of Frost[/b][/i]
Elf: Bonus Attack Power per upgrade changed from ×1 → ×1.5
Orc: Bonus Attack Power per upgrade changed from ×1 → ×0.7[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Shackles of Precision[/i][/b]   
Human: Critical Damage Bonus +250%  
Elf: Critical Chance set to 0%[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Savage Roar[/b][/i]
Orc: Attack Speed +30%
Elf: Attack Speed -15%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Support Rune[/p][list][*][p][b][i]Totem of Opportunity[/i][/b] Summons a totem on the map. The totem generates 10 to 100 Blue Souls randomly every 7 waves.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]QoL Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Holding down on a sell icon for more than 3 seconds now triggers [b]auto-sell[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Normal Summon Hotkey \[Q][/b] has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Bulk sell feature added - Right-click[/p][/*][*][p]A pause function has been added. [/p][list][*][p]Pressing ESC will pause the game. [/p][/*][*][p]This is only available in single-player mode and will not apply to future co-op play[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][/h2][h3]Balance Changes[/h3][p]Some underperforming runes have been [b]merged or removed[/b] to improve overall rune quality.[/p][list][*][p][b]Hawk Eye & Longshot [/b]merged.
[i]New Hawk Eye effect:[/i]
→ Attack Range +50%
→ Normal Damage +3% per Attack Range[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fateful Blow & Critical Fury[/b] merged. [/p][p][i]New Fateful Blow effect:[/i] 
→ Critical Chance +20% 
→ Critical Damage Bonus +100%[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Red Soul rewards from event bosses in the late game (after Wave 100) have been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Support Rune Balancing Adjustments[/p][list][*][p]"Gambler's Instinct" Probability Adjustment (50% -> 12%)[/p][/*][*][p]"This Kind of Luck" Probability Adjustment (20% -> 10%)[/p][p][i]We have confirmed that in the late game, there is an excessive accumulation of currency beyond our initial projections. This was beginning to affect the intended gameplay flow. Furthermore, to prevent potential optimization issues that could arise from an excessive number of simultaneous summons in the late-game multiplayer environment currently in development, we have unavoidably adjusted the balance of support runes downward. This decision was made to ensure a better and more stable gaming environment.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]UI / UX[/h3][list][*][p]Wave info UI has been moved to the upper-left section of the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now check how each attack rune affects Attack Power, clearly distinguishing between additive calculation and multiplicative calculation.[/p][/*][*][p]Some rune descriptions have been revised for better clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Performance & Stability[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a memory dump issue related to Human explosion skills that affected long-term stability.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the game would not end after defeating the final Epic Boss in Wave 150.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect damage calculation for Elf 8-star’s Ice Blast skill.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a tooltip bug where certain descriptions would follow the mouse cursor and not close properly.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature:
Detailed Combat Stats HUD
You can now view detailed damage statistics for the current wave by pressing the [b]Tab[/b] key in-game.
This HUD displays the [b]Total Damage categorized by race and tier of current enemies[/b], along with the breakdown of [b]Base Damage[/b] and [b]Skill Damage[/b]. Additionally, we have included information about the Armor Reduction from physical and magic resistance for the current wave, based on your collected Runes and upgrade progress.

[i][b]Pact of Frost[/b][/i]
Elf: Bonus Attack Power per upgrade changed from ×1 → ×1.5
Orc: Bonus Attack Power per upgrade changed from ×1 → ×0.7

[b][i]Shackles of Precision[/i][/b]   
Human: Critical Damage Bonus +250%  
Elf: Critical Chance set to 0%

[i][b]Savage Roar[/b][/i]
Orc: Attack Speed +30%
Elf: Attack Speed -15%
[b][i]Totem of Opportunity[/i][/b] Summons a totem on the map. The totem generates 10 to 100 Blue Souls randomly every 7 waves.
Holding down on a sell icon for more than 3 seconds now triggers [b]auto-sell[/b].

A pause function has been added. 
Pressing ESC will pause the game. 
This is only available in single-player mode and will not apply to future co-op play

tags.balance_change:
[b]Hawk Eye & Longshot [/b]merged. 
[i]New Hawk Eye effect:[/i]
→ Attack Range +50%
→ Normal Damage +3% per Attack Range

[b]Fateful Blow & Critical Fury[/b] merged. 
[i]New Fateful Blow effect:[/i] 
→ Critical Chance +20% 
→ Critical Damage Bonus +100%
Red Soul rewards from event bosses in the late game (after Wave 100) have been reduced.
"Gambler's Instinct" Probability Adjustment (50% -> 12%)
"This Kind of Luck" Probability Adjustment (20% -> 10%)
Wave info UI has been moved to the upper-left section of the screen.
You can now check how each attack rune affects Attack Power, clearly distinguishing between additive calculation and multiplicative calculation.
Some rune descriptions have been revised for better clarity.

tags.bug: Fixed a memory dump issue related to Human explosion skills that affected long-term stability.
Fixed a bug where the game would not end after defeating the final Epic Boss in Wave 150.
Fixed incorrect damage calculation for Elf 8-star’s Ice Blast skill.
Fixed a tooltip bug where certain descriptions would follow the mouse cursor and not close properly.
